notes.title: More Panda Slot Creator Update v1.3
notes.content:
Minor updates and fixes.
Increased number of free spins symbols on reels 1,2,3
Increased number of scattered symbols on reels. 1 and 5
Increased number of 2x and 5x symbols on free spins.
Updated game directory to include additional directories for the upcoming game addons.
Each new addon game will be a standalone game with editor.
